# Ojusvi

> Ojusvi is an Indian wellness and companionship app for adults 55+ and their families, operated by Ojusvi Goodhealth Private Limited. It offers live daily yoga and pranayama, guided meditation, the daily panchang, bhajan and satsang, gentle brain games, live afternoon Tambola with the community, and Samvit — medicine reminders and health records — in six Indian languages.

## Audience

- Adults 55 and over in India, including complete beginners and members who have not exercised in years.
- Families (sons, daughters, spouses) setting up a daily routine for ageing parents.

## Languages

English, Hindi, Bangla, Marathi, Telugu, Tamil — every screen, not just the classes.

## Platforms

- iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/ojusvi/id6792540529
- Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ojusvi.app
- Web: live classes can be watched on a laptop at /watch with a Full (Monthly or Annual) membership.

## Plans

- Lite: ₹99/month, recurring — mobile app only.
- Monthly: ₹349/month, recurring — mobile app and laptop access.
- Annual: ₹2,988 billed once for 12 months (₹249/month) — mobile app and laptop access.
- Every new user gets the first 30 days free, no card needed.

## Health note

Ojusvi offers general wellness, yoga and lifestyle guidance. It does not diagnose, treat or cure medical conditions and is not a substitute for advice from a doctor. It is not an emergency or monitoring service.
